verdict.rationale: Prototyping is a fair axis for a design tool, but the evidence never documents wiring screens into clickable prototypes with triggers, transitions, and overlays. Rive explicitly positions itself as 'No mockups, no prototypes, no handoff.' Its documented interactivity, interactive graphics that respond to user input and state machines, is an adjacent capability rather than no-code screen-flow prototyping.

support.subject: As a designer, I can wire screens into clickable prototypes with triggers, transitions, and overlays — no code required
